receiver.beta_policy: constant phase-function ratio beta/alpha from Hahner default MOR relation; unverified for spatially variable droplet size
receiver.origin_policy: original hard when selected range is the exact target range and hard power dominates; pure soft is weather; shifted/mixed peaks unknown; component powers recorded
receiver.receiver_policy: strongest total waveform peak; not the STF last-return selector
receiver.threshold_status: uncalibrated_approximation: digital-encoding quantization only; no physical threshold assumed

response_randomness: none; deterministic continuum scattering; field identity is the complete stochastic input

sampling.estimator: fixed stratified sample ratio: sum(n_h/m_h * I*T) / sum(n_h/m_h * I); sampled approximation
sampling.priority: Clean common-observation targets first; round robin; point-identity hash order

selection.choice: first lexical P7 development scenes; original two frames
